claims.text: Users report improved gum health and positive feedback from their dental hygienists after using the brush.
The brush is valued for cleaning between teeth and along the gum line, though it does not replace floss.
Some customers report receiving incomplete or incorrect orders, such as missing tips or items not matching the picture.
Several reviewers note the bristles feel softer or less dense than earlier versions.
Reviewers find the product long-lasting and economical, especially when buying refill tips in bulk.
